meta.name: comparison-page-builder
meta.description: Use when the user asks to "build a vs page", "competitor comparison page", or "[Competitor] alternative page"; produces ready-to-publish comparison/alternative pages in four formats with an honesty rule and one source of truth per competitor. Not for researching competitors or scoring a SERP — use competitor-analysis; not for general article drafting — use seo-content-writer. 对比页/vs页/替代页

copy.tagline: 快速生成竞品对比页，提升转化率
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要制作产品对比页面来吸引客户。
copy.tagline_en: Generate competitor comparison pages quickly to boost conversions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to create product comparison pages to attract customers.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据你的产品信息和竞争对手数据，生成四种格式的对比页或替代页（如“你 vs 竞争对手”或“[竞争对手] 替代品”），并附带一个可复用的竞争对手数据文件。
howto.when: 当你要求“制作一个 vs 页面”、“竞争对手对比页面”或“[竞争对手] 替代页面”时触发。也适用于“我们和 X 相比如何”、“battle card 页面”或“[A] vs [B]”等说法。

say.text: 制作一个我们 vs 竞争对手A的对比页面。
say.note: Claude 会要求你提供产品定位和竞争对手信息。

say.text: 写一篇“[竞争对手B] 替代品”页面，列出多个真实选项。
say.note: Claude 会生成包含多个替代方案的列表页。

say.text: 为我们的产品做一个 vs 竞争对手C的 battle card 页面。
say.note: Claude 会生成一个快速对比卡片。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate comparison or alternative pages in four formats (e.g., 'you vs competitor' or '[Competitor] alternatives') based on your product info and competitor data, along with a reusable competitor data file.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to 'build a vs page', 'competitor comparison page', or '[Competitor] alternative page'. Also for 'how do we compare to X', 'battle card page', or '[A] vs [B]'.

say_en.text: Build a vs page comparing us to Competitor A.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for your positioning and competitor info.

say_en.text: Write a '[Competitor B] alternatives' page listing real options.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a list page with multiple alternatives.

say_en.text: Create a battle card page for our product vs Competitor C.
say_en.note: Claude will produce a quick comparison card.
